title: 14.35. Niyataduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Niyataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Aniyataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Niyatañca aniyatañca dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate pañca.
